selection: Full-source network and nested training population declared before Round2. Parameters estimated only from 2014-2019. Historical results and 2026 ranking illustrations were inspected before this freeze; only later saved-before-kickoff forecasts qualify as future evidence.
achievement: Exact excluded-game SOR with average source-FBS reference; unchanged all-source Colley network, no extra division weight in graph or record. The baseline refit has the same training games and zero division coefficient.
forecasts: Separate prior-week-calibrated coefficients on current full graph, no target outcome. Available known-D1 FBS-involving unfinished fixtures only; kickoff strictly after snapshot and actual checksummed capture, within seven days. No complete-schedule claim.
evaluation: First eligible immutable forecast per model/game, never selected by result; confirmed later outcomes with matched identity/venue. Exclude corrected kickoff outside the seven-day window or before capture. Score FBS-FBS and FBS-FCS separately. Recurring teams and small future samples require caution.
sourceCorrections: Documented versioned corrections may change shared inputs; keep normalized/source hashes and original observations. No team overrides, polls, conference prestige or parameter retuning.
operations: Existing Sunday08:00America/Denver refresh, same two successful CFBD calls; no new service or additional provider calls. Research failures do not block public rankings or old frozenv1.
limits: Historical FCS regular-season and lower-division coverage is not universally certified.
Season2020 spring tournament and roster gaps remain; excluded from fitting and pooled later evaluation.
Selected mostly-FBS-home schedules do not identify a causal neutral-field division gap.
A better probability mapping does not alone validate a fairer achievement order.
changePolicy: New parameters or numerical code require a new protocol version; preserve this file and prior observations.
versionNotes: Before any real collection, v2 adds prewrite and completed-write kickoff guards. A failed new capture cannot become prospective evidence. Coefficients and numerical probability calculations are unchanged from division-sor-v1. Both protocol files and Git implementation history are retained.
